title: append
body:
## append

Combines the meshes of several input nodes (any dataset types, non-composite) into one unstructured grid, ParaView 5.13.3's default output type for Append Datasets. Points are not merged and only point and cell arrays present on every input are kept. Use it to treat parts as one dataset for a filter or export; use appendGeometry for surfaces, group to keep inputs as separate blocks, and merge for the blocks of one composite node.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Arrays missing on any input are dropped; make array names consistent across inputs first.
- Coincident points at part interfaces stay duplicated; follow with cleanGrid to merge them.

Native constructor: `AppendDatasets`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "append",
  "inputs": {
    "input": [
      "UPSTREAM_input"
    ]
  }
}
```
